parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: language should be in the list: ["en", "zh-Hans"]

parameters.name: merchant_id
parameters.description: Shopee’s unique identifier for a merchant. Required for all merchant level requests(CB CNSC user calling global product related APIs).

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, merchant_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: size_chart_table
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: new size chart is a table format which include multiple columns. each column has column header (measurement) and multiple values (measurement value) of this column.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: column_list
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: column list of new size chart table. it include one column (measurement) and multiple values (measurement value)

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: measurement
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: this is the column header which means a kind of measurement

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: input_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: there are 3 kinds of measurement type: Single Dropdown, Input Single Number, Input Range Number.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: unit
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: the unit of this size measurement.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: value
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: if the input_type of measurement is single input number, measurement will have one value which is returned by this field.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: min_value
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: if the input_type of measurement is input range number, measurement will be a range which is returned by 2 fields: min_value and max_value.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: max_value
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: if the input_type of measurement is input range number, measurement will be a range which is returned by 2 fields: min_value and max_value.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: option
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: if the input_type of measurement is single dropdown, measurement will have one value which is returned by this field.
